title: Gokul hikes buffalo milk price by ₹6, cow milk by ₹4; farmers unhappy
description:
The Kolhapur District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union, popularly known as Gokul Milk Union, has decided to increase the selling price of buffalo milk by Rs 6 per litre and cow milk by Rs 4 per litre with immediate effect, its chairman Rajesh Patil said on Saturday.
The decision was taken unanimously by all 25 directors due to the drought situation and the difficulties faced by farmers, Patil, a former MLA, said.
The union has also decided to raise the procurement rates paid to milk producers by Rs 3 per litre for buffalo milk and Rs 2 per litre for cow milk, he said, adding that this hike was "historic".
"The revised rates will come into effect from November 21 and remain applicable for around 131 days, till March. The situation will be reviewed every month, and the board will take further decisions depending on the circumstances," Patil said.
